confirmedFindings.title: defer inside high-iteration loop causes file descriptor exhaustion
confirmedFindings.body: Placing defer f.Close() inside a loop delays closing file descriptors until ImportLogs returns, risking "too many open files" OS errors when processing many files.
confirmedFindings.suggestion: Wrap the per-file processing inside an anonymous function func() { ... defer f.Close() }() or call f.Close() directly at the end of each iteration.
